intro: Answer 5 quick questions and get a personalized, day-by-day 30-day plan — specific tasks, the exact portal tools to use, and creators to follow. 100% free. 2–3 hours a day.

weeks.title: Foundation & Setup
weeks.focus: Get your setup, mindset, and core skills right.

days.task: Confirm equipment & workspace with the Equipment Checker.
Watch the full walkthrough. Take notes on the 9-step roadmap.
Learn your first core tool (Google Workspace basics).
Explore niches. Shortlist your top two directions.
Open Build Labs. Learn the anatomy of a resume — don't write it yet.
Practice: complete one small mock task in your chosen niche.
Review week 1. Rest. Write down why you started.

weeks.title: Build Your Assets
weeks.focus: Create the profile, resume, and portfolio that get replies.

days.task: Find 5 real resumes for your target role. Extract the rules they share.
Write your resume from those rules, on a blank page. It's yours.
Write your own prompt to critique it — learn the anatomy of a prompt.
Learn your niche's #1 tool to a working level.
Start a free certification for your niche.
Build your own application tracker — schema and formulas, from scratch.
Review. Get feedback in the community group.

weeks.title: Apply Relentlessly
weeks.focus: Work the directory. Track everything. Prep to interview.

days.task: Open the Apply directory. Shortlist 20 places to apply.
Send 5 tailored applications using the AI message prompt.
Send 5 more. Log each in your tracker.
Run a mock interview with the Interview Coach Bot.
Send 5 more applications. Follow up on day-1 sends.
Learn the negotiation basics. Set your target rate.
Review pipeline. Adjust your message based on replies.

weeks.title: Interview, Close & Deliver
weeks.focus: Convert interviews, land the offer, and start strong.

days.task: Send 10 applications. Quality over speed.
Do 2 real interviews. Debrief each with AI.
Handle any rejection: extract the lesson, keep going.
Negotiate an offer using your prepared script.
Prep your first-week onboarding kit.
Write the SOPs and build the trackers your new role needs.
Deliver a proactive first update. Impress early.
Plan your niche + language path for months 2–3.
Share your win. Pull the next person up.
